name: Wave Wipe
description: A breaking wave crashes across the frame, its lip curling over in front of its face and throwing foam and spray ahead, its shadow darkening the first clip; the second clip is left behind it, tinted and bent by the water, clearing as the wave passes. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the wave travels toward (x right, y up)

params.name: curl
params.description: Size of the curling lip, in wave heights: how far it overhangs ahead of the face

params.name: foam
params.description: Amount of foam on the crest and spray thrown ahead of it

params.name: refraction
params.description: How much the water bends the second clip behind the wave

params.name: water
params.description: Color of the water tinting the second clip behind the wave (alpha: strength)

params.name: foam_color
params.description: Color of the foam and spray (alpha: strength)
